thread:
maya (sales): Kicking off the GraniteHealth pilot thread. Need to lock scope: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, domain proofing, and a pricing/ops plan for a 2-week dedicated pilot. Chris, confirm domains + any compliance notes?

chris (GraniteHealth): Primary: granitehealth.com. Also include staging.granitehealth.internal and api.granitehealth.com (traffic will go to api). For compliance: we need audit trails for 1 year and customer-managed keys for logs.

sam (solutions): Thanks. High-level plan:
- Domain verification: DNS TXT recommended for production domains. We'll also support metadata-file verification if needed for staging.
- SAML: we support SP-initiated + IdP-initiated flows, encrypted assertions, and NameID formats (email/persistent).
- SCIM: v2 provisioning with group sync -> RBAC mapping. Delta sync frequency configurable (recommended 10m for pilot).

Quick SAML config snippet you can share with IdP team: 
- ACS URL: https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs/gh-pilot
- EntityID (SP): https://redwood.ai/saml/gh-pilot
- Requested NameID: email
- Want encrypted assertions: yes (we can accept RSA-OAEP + AES-256)

sam (solutions): SCIM base: https://api.redwood.ai/scim/gh-pilot/v2
Provisioning token: will issue per-environment (no long-lived shared passwords).

Example SCIM user create payload for Okta:
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "a.jones@granitehealth.com",
  "name": {"givenName": "Alice","familyName": "Jones"},
  "emails": [{"value": "a.jones@granitehealth.com","primary": true}],
  "externalId": "okta|67890",
  "active": true,
  "groups": [{"value": "platform_ops"}]
}
```

sam (solutions): Recommended group->role mapping for pilot (we'll provision mappings):
- platform_ops -> platform-admin
- eng_sre -> developer
- contractors -> limited-access

maya (sales): Pricing options for the 2-week pilot:
A) Shared hosted pilot: free credits, no dedicated capacity SLA, basic telemetry.
B) Dedicated pilot: reserved node (1x A100-equivalent) + VPC peering option: flat $7,500 for two weeks (includes extended audit retention and KMS enabled).
C) Private deploy (customer-managed control plane): longer lead time, enterprise contract.

chris (GraniteHealth): We'll go Dedicated. We can sign PO. Need VPC peering; will provide CIDR and contact by EOD tomorrow.

lee (security): Security checklist for pilot:
- KMS for logs: enable customer key (we'll need key ARN)
- Audit log retention: set to 365 days
- IP allowlist for pilot endpoints (we can add VPC peering later)
- mTLS: optional; not required for pilot but supported
- Data processing addendum (DPA) + SOC2 docs: we'll attach to the vendor packet

nina (legal): We'll review the DPA and scope of data processing. Please attach the completed vendor security questionnaire to the PO. A couple legal asks: minimum liability cap, and clarity on export controls for medical data.

sam (solutions): I'll prepare the peering/network checklist and the DNS TXT template for domain verification. Short DNS TXT example: 
- Name: _redwood-verification.granitehealth.com
- Value: gh-pilot-9f7a2c3d

sam (solutions): For peering we'll need:
- Customer VPC CIDR
- ASN
- Peer contact email and escalation phone
- Expected egress IP ranges (for allowlist)

maya (sales): Action items:
- chris: send PO + CIDR + key ARN by EOD tomorrow (to get Dedicated nodes provisioned).
- chris: provide 3 test users per group for RBAC smoke tests (ops/dev/contractors).
- sam: drop metadata XML and SCIM token into this thread once generated.
- lee: attach vendor sec-qa template.

chris (GraniteHealth): Will do. Also can you confirm how we handle account reconciliation for users with multiple emails? We sometimes have personal+work emails.

sam (solutions): Use SCIM externalId for canonical linking (we recommend Okta externalId or Okta user id). We also support matching on primary email but externalId is more robust. We'll include an import/reconcile step prior to syncing.

lee (security): One more: please include the retention policy for SAML assertion logs and access to audit exports. We'll provision a secure S3 bucket with restricted access for exports during the pilot.

maya (sales): Thanks all. I'll send a one-page summary and the dedicated pilot invoice draft after sam uploads the metadata. /cc @sam @lee

chris (GraniteHealth): Thanks team, appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
